title: From an Idea to a Working Product, and Always Improving
description: The recommended sequence for making any idea real, software or physical, and keeping it working and improving: set up the model and the person, found the project on written reasons, design what people and agents use, build it in traced changes, take it to production quality, and improve it continuously after launch. A project in any state enters where its state says, and every entry leads to the same path. Each step names when it is done, and the other skills it calls on.

steps.title: Set up the model and the person
steps.description: Turn one model into the agent that builds the project: it builds its own harness and tools if it has none, and proves them. Ask the person everything only they can answer, at the start, and set the standing limits. Then put the sandbox, the checkpoints and the gates in place, so development runs without waiting and nothing is called done until it passes.
steps.done_when: the harness passes harness/conformance.py, the briefing is answered with its standing limits, and the sandbox, checkpoints and gates are in place.

steps.title: Start from the idea
steps.description: Work out what it takes to make the idea happen and how it is paid for. Make the few decisions that are costly to reverse with verified evidence. Make every stage of the pipeline a command a person or an agent can run, and build one thin slice end to end. The ledger it writes gives every later step its reasons. For a project that already exists, write the ledger from what is there.
steps.done_when: the owner has agreed the path and its first step, the ledger passes the trace check, and the walking skeleton has run end to end and been rolled back once.

steps.title: Make it run from cold
steps.description: Dependencies install, the tests run to completion, and nothing reports success while broken, so every later step starts from a baseline rather than an assumption.
steps.done_when: a clean checkout installs and runs its tests with one command, and breaking a step makes that command fail.

steps.title: Design what people and agents use
steps.description: Design every journey as a flow, with every state and every word, before breadth is built. Keep one system of look and behaviour in code, make every action operable by a person, an agent or automation with the same limits, and keep the design threaded to the architecture. Settle taste with the owner and everything else with evidence, and test each journey with people, or stand-ins labelled as such.
steps.done_when: each journey that must never fail is a flow with every state and word designed, operable by a person and an agent with the same limits, threaded to the architecture with no empty cell, and tested with people or labelled stand-ins until its target holds.

steps.title: Choose with evidence, whenever a choice matters
steps.description: Compare real options for each consequential choice, including building it and combining several. Use criteria from the goal, back the decision with at least two pieces of evidence (one verified), redo every number, and keep a way out.
steps.done_when: the decision record passes the trace check, and the owner has approved it if it is costly to reverse.

steps.title: Build in changes that each have a reason
steps.description: Every milestone and every request, however vaguely worded, is translated into a measure, verified before and after, built through every layer it touches, and traced to the goal, with nothing left behind.
steps.done_when: every claim in the request is accounted for, every commit has its Serves and Verified lines, the measure moved, and nothing is left detached.

steps.title: Take it to production quality
steps.description: Write the bar, then close the gap in order of what it costs the people who use it: nothing lost, the core job on every platform, finished to use, nothing it does not need. Every item ends as holds, broken or skipped.
steps.done_when: every row of the bar holds, or is broken or skipped with its reason and its next step in the plan.

steps.title: Review what the agent produced
steps.description: Check each pull request against the claims it makes about itself, and break the code under every new test to see it go red.
steps.done_when: every claim the pull request makes is checked, and every new test has been seen to fail.

steps.title: Keep it on course and improving, for good
steps.description: At every milestone and continuously after launch: take every measure again from its source, switch routes where a course change fired, remove what no longer serves the goal, run the pipeline both ways, and rank the next improvements. The project continues, adjusts, re-routes or grows; it is never left half-done.
steps.done_when: every measure was taken from its source this run, the next improvements are ranked into the next milestone, and the ledger is committed. Then it starts again.

steps.title: Keep it current
steps.description: Update dependencies in small, verified steps, so staying current never becomes a rewrite.
steps.done_when: each update is its own verified commit, and the suite passes on the new versions.

entries.state: An idea, and only a language model to build it with
entries.note: The model builds its own harness and tools and proves them, the person is asked everything only they can answer in one sitting, and the build then runs without waiting.

entries.state: An idea, and an agent that already works
entries.note: What it takes, the costly decisions with evidence, a pipeline anyone can run, and one slice end to end.

entries.state: A project that already exists, in any state: a prototype, a half-built or vibe-coded build, an inherited codebase, or a working product with gaps
entries.note: Found it again on paper: the ledger written from what is there, every decision it embodies recorded with the evidence it had, and those nobody can justify marked for revisiting. Then make it run from cold, and close the gap.

entries.state: Live, and it has to keep working and getting better
entries.note: Every measure taken again from its source, the next improvements ranked by what they move, on a steady cadence for as long as it serves anyone.
The review finds the route that is blocked and the next route to the same goal. Nothing is declared dead.

entries.state: A request, however it is worded: 'optimise it', 'make it pretty', 'add AI'
entries.note: Translated into the measure it moves, verified before and after, built through every layer it touches.

entries.state: A choice between options: a tool, a vendor, a part, a design, a route
entries.note: Real options, criteria from the goal, at least two backings with one verified, and a way out.
Every claim it makes checked, and every new test seen to fail.

throughout.when: the project is private, proprietary or offline, or any of its work must not leave
it moves, heats, dispenses, spends or sends: hardware, devices or real-world services
